name: B47ANCE'd Fences & Gates

features.text: 41 paid fence parts and 6 gates use vanilla artwork. All 47 recipes are exercised through 19 grouped construction entries in offline tests; a secondary-only native list retains its family entry. Individual recipe requirements and costs are preserved.
Native BuildLogic construction owns payment and placement; server/SP callbacks validate object identity and apply bounded health settings. Client selection is presentation only.
Server sandbox settings control new construction health and automatic junction posts for the four supported fence families.
Custom transparent mod icon uses only the real vanilla wooden fence. Existing Workshop thumbnail and poster are preserved.
SP and dedicated multiplayer acceptance remain untested; stable-release G8 is blocked. Workshop distribution is an MP testing build.

limits: Lua-only runtime. Source review and 75 offline regressions do not prove runtime collision, gates, payment, save/reload or dedicated synchronization. Five unavailable original-installed-baseline checks remain blocked.
